description: London Unified Prayer Timetable Fajr/Isha interval table (minutes). fajr = (sunrise_published + 3) - fajr_interval; isha = (magrib_published - 3) + isha_interval. Base: Y.A. Miftahi "Fajar and Isha" Tables 5/6 (image transcription, carry-forward of "-"). isha_interval_2026 includes London edits found in every era-B year (2015, 2017-2022, 2024-2026) plus 16-19 Jun edits seen in 2025 and 2026 only. Derived from lpt-2026.json (API) and ELM PDFs; per-year values in data/london_interval_table.json.
